UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -Command "$src = '{{GameInstallPath}}'; $dst = '{{$FullBaseDir}}game'; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $src 'dedicatedServer.exe'))) { Write-Output 'ERROR: No Farming Simulator 19 installation was found at the configured Game Installation Path.'; Write-Output '       Farming Simulator 19 cannot be downloaded automatically. Install it on this machine first, then update this instance again.'; exit 1 }; $i = Get-Item $dst -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($i -and -not $i.LinkType) { Write-Output 'ERROR: A real folder already exists where the game link should go. Remove it and update again.'; exit 1 }; if ($i) { Remove-Item $dst -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $dst -Target $src *> $null; Write-Output ('Linked game installation from ' + $src)"
